display.purpose: Bedtime-wheel time readout only — the single largest number in the app.

eyebrow.purpose: One warm italic-serif framing line above a screen title. Max one per screen.

screenTitle.purpose: Per-tab greeting / Now Playing title / quiz question.

body.purpose: Setting-row and option-row titles inside list cards.

navLabel.purpose: Dock tab labels; weight flips 500→700 on the active tab.

motion.name: press-scale
motion.purpose: App-wide press feedback for buttons, chips, and pressable rows — replaces opacity-only dimming.

motion.name: select-crossfade
motion.purpose: Selected/deselected color transition on chips and the toggle track.

motion.name: toggle-knob-spring
motion.purpose: Toggle knob's physical position change — deliberately a different animation type than its own track's color crossfade.

motion.name: breathe
motion.value: scale 1→1.045, 7s ease-in-out, infinite, disabled under prefers-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: The one ambient/looping animation in the app, on the Now Playing moon ring.

motion.name: mini-player-enter
motion.purpose: Dock mini-player arrival/departure — never a flat opacity swap, never scale(0).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width 54px pill CTA. One per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 54px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 999px; border: none; background: #d97e52; color: #2b130a; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(230,140,90,0.26); transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f2b48c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action — transparent fill, hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 54px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(242,180,140,0.14); color: #f6ede9; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Toggle
components.description: 44×26px switch. Track color and knob position animate on separate curves (color = timing, position = spring).
components.css: .ds-toggle { width: 44px; height: 26px; border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px; border: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.09); transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.77,0,0.175,1); } .ds-toggle-on { background: #d97e52; justify-content: flex-end; } .ds-toggle-knob { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 999px; background: #85716f; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.77,0,0.175,1); } .ds-toggle-on .ds-toggle-knob { background: #ffe9d6; }

components.name: Selectable Chip
components.description: 44px pill, crossfades between inactive (card+stroke) and active (button+buttonText) on selection, plus a haptic on commit.
components.css: .ds-chip { height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(242,180,140,0.14); background: #251a22; color: #b49c99; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.77,0,0.175,1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.77,0,0.175,1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.77,0,0.175,1); } .ds-chip-active { background: #d97e52; border-color: #d97e52; color: #2b130a; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: List Row Card
components.description: The dominant Sleep/Profile content pattern: bare icon, label + optional subtitle, trailing value/chevron/toggle, rows separated by hairlines inside one card.
components.html:
●
Gentle fade-out
Volume lowers as you drift
components.css: .ds-list-card { background: #251a22; border: 1px solid rgba(242,180,140,0.14); border-radius: 20px; padding: 6px 14px; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 56px; } .ds-row-icon { color: #f2b48c; font-size: 20px; } .ds-row-title { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #f6ede9; } .ds-row-subtitle { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px; color: #85716f; margin-top: 2px; }

components.name: Dock Nav Item
components.description: One of 3 destinations (Explore/Sleep/Profile) in the edge-to-edge bottom bar. Active state is color+weight only — no pill highlight, no dot.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 3px; min-width: 58px; min-height: 48px; background: transparent; border: none; color: #85716f; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-item-active { color: #f2b48c; font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav-icon { font-size: 21px; }

narrative.overview: Pulvio is a sleep-sounds app, and every visual decision serves exactly one goal: lower the user's arousal level. The UI is meant to be the last calm thing someone sees before they put the phone down — not a dashboard, not a feed, not a thing that competes for attention. Dusk Ember is the implemented direction: a near-black plum base lit only by a single warm peach/ember glow, rendered as soft layered radial gradients rather than any hard light source. There is one hue family in the whole app. There is no light mode — night is the product, not a theme option. The system is deliberately restrained rather than richly decorated: flat surfaces, no drop shadows, no blur or frosted glass, no icon chips, no gamification. If an element would excite a half-asleep user rather than settle them, it doesn't belong. The one animated exception is a slow ambient breathe — everything else fades or resolves quickly and quietly.
keyCharacteristics: Dark plum base + one warm ember glow, applied as radial-gradient washes, never a hard light or blur
Flat by default — depth comes from tonal layering and glow, never box-shadow
Bare content icons in the accent color, no tinted icon-chip backgrounds
Ionicons outline glyphs carry all iconography — not custom stroke SVGs

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: Every accent, highlight, and glow shares the same peach/ember hue family. A second hue is a signal something has gone off-brief, not a design decision to make locally.

rules.name: The Button-Text Rule
rules.body: Text or an icon drawn directly on button (#d97e52) is always buttonText (#2b130a). White-on-ember never happens, even for a single label.

rules.name: The One Lora Rule
rules.body: At most one italic-serif moment per screen. Lora marks warmth (a greeting, a scene name); it never labels a control or a setting row.

rules.name: The No-Blur Rule
rules.body: All atmosphere and depth comes from layered radial/linear gradients. blur()/BlurView never appears, anywhere, for any reason.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces sit flat against their background. The only thing that lifts a surface visually is a glow wash underneath it, never a shadow.

dos: Do keep every accent, highlight, and glow inside the single peach/ember hue family (accent/button/glow/glowSoft).
Do put buttonText on anything drawn directly on a button-colored surface, never white or text.
Do use the scale-press feedback recipe (~0.97 scale, ~150ms, cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1)) for new pressables instead of an opacity-only press state.
Do build depth with tonal layering and radial-gradient glow washes, never box-shadow or blur.
Do give every card/row a 1px stroke border at rest, upgrading to accent on selection.
donts: Don't put a tinted rounded-square/circle chip behind a content icon. Icons sit bare in their accent color. (Round control buttons keep their own circular background.)
Don't add streaks, badges, unread-style counters, confetti, or red notification dots.
Don't use blur()/BlurView anywhere; every soft edge in this app is a gradient, never a blur.
Don't assume passing strokeWidth to an icon component changes anything visually — the icon set is Ionicons glyphs now, and that prop is inert.
Don't build a second primary CTA on a screen that already has one.
